papers.title: Development of an integrated Sasang constitution diagnosis method using face, body shape, voice, and questionnaire information
papers.authors: Do Jun-Hyeong et al. (KIOM)
papers.design: Cross-sectional modelling study using Korean oriental-medicine clinic data. Four separate multinomial logistic regression models (face, body shape, voice, questionnaire) were combined into one integrated model, following practitioners' holistic four-part examination. The split sizes (training 2,462, test 511, 729 with all four modalities, 241 M / 488 F) were NOT shown in my search results and are unconfirmed.
papers.findings: Integrated model accuracy was 64.0% in male and 55.2% in female patients. With a cut-off of 1.6 on the integrated score, accuracy rose by a further 14.7% (male) and 4.6% (female). The search results did not show face-only accuracy.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 얼굴, 체형(BMI), 설문을 결합하는 키오스크 구조의 가장 직접적인 근거입니다. 모달리티마다 체질 확률을 따로 계산해 합치고, 통합 점수가 임계값보다 낮으면 '판정 보류 / 경향만 표시'로 처리하세요. 논문도 cut-off 1.6을 적용했을 때 정확도가 올라갔습니다. 사용자에게 보여줄 정직한 기준선은 '음성까지 포함한 통합모델도 정확도 약 55–64%'이며, 얼굴만으로는 이보다 높다고 말할 근거가 없다는 점도 함께 고지하세요.

papers.title: Modification of the Integrated Sasang Constitutional Diagnostic Model
papers.authors: Nam J, Jang JS, Kim, Kim, Do JH
papers.design: Cross-sectional model revision using 2007-2011 data from 2,773 subjects, typed by Sasang experts via constitutional prescriptions in 23 oriental medical clinics. The authors targeted three problems in the 2012 model: predicted type ratios did not match actual proportions, explanatory variables were multicollinear, and the four components were weighted equally. Fixes: within-component variable selection, LASSO, component weighting, and type proportions and age taken into account when splitting training and test sets. The subset counts (1,891 complete; 657 M / 1,234 F) were not visible in the results and are unconfirmed.
papers.findings: Sensitivity rose for male So-yang (36.4% to 62.0%) and female So-eum (43.7% to 64.5%). Overall and per-modality accuracies were not shown in the search results.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 남성 소양인과 여성 소음인은 기존 통합모델이 가장 놓치기 쉬운 유형이었습니다. 따라서 성별로 모델 또는 가중치를 분리하세요. 모달리티끼리 상관이 높으면(예: 얼굴 폭과 BMI) 정규화(LASSO) 같은 방식으로 중복 기여를 줄이고, 모달리티 가중치를 동일하게 두지 말고 데이터로 정하세요. 실제 체질 분포(유형 비율)를 사전확률로 반영해야 예측 비율이 왜곡되지 않는다는 점도 이 논문의 근거입니다.

papers.title: Analysis of Sasang constitutional types using facial features with compensation for photographic distance
papers.authors: Do Jun-Hyeong, Ku Boncho, Jang Jun-Su, Kim Honggie, Kim Jong Yeol
papers.design: Cross-sectional study of frontal and profile photographs from 1,464 patients at 19 oriental medical clinics. The search results did not show the method used to confirm Sasang type; the 'improvement after one month of medicine' criterion is unconfirmed.
papers.findings: A compensation technique was verified to reduce site-to-site variability caused by differing photographic distances, and the statistical analysis then identified facial features that significantly distinguish SC types. The specific variables and effect sizes were not visible. (A 'So-eum: small jaw area, long philtrum, narrow egg-like face' description appeared in the same results but comes from a separate 2010 Jang et al. study, not this paper.)
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 촬영 거리와 장비 차이가 얼굴 측정값을 오염시킨다는 직접 근거입니다. MediaPipe 랜드마크는 절대 픽셀 거리 대신 동공 간 거리처럼 기준 길이로 정규화한 비율을 쓰세요. 촬영 거리와 고개 각도(yaw/pitch/roll)가 허용 범위 안에 있을 때만 자동 캡처하도록 안내 UI를 두세요.

papers.title: Sasang Constitution Classification using Convolutional Neural Network on Facial Images (콘볼루션 신경망 기반의 안면영상을 이용한 사상체질 분류)
papers.authors: Ahn Ilkoo, Kim Sang-Hyuk, Jeong Kyoungsik, Kim Hoseok, Lee Siwoo (KIOM)
papers.design: Cross-sectional deep-learning study using facial images of 3,738 subjects. VGG16 transfer learning with data augmentation, run as three binary one-vs-rest tasks: TE vs non-TE, SE vs non-SE, SY vs non-SY.
papers.findings: Accuracy was 77.24% for TE/non-TE, 85.17% for SE/non-SE and 80.18% for SY/non-SY. So-eum was the most distinguishable type, followed by So-yang, with Tae-eum the lowest. This CORRECTS the earlier claim that the order was So-eum > Tae-eum > So-yang. The authors suggest that adding data such as BMI or a personality questionnaire could improve performance. AUC was not shown.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 얼굴 이미지만 쓴 이진 분류 정확도는 소음 85.17%, 소양 80.18%, 태음 77.24% 순입니다(기존 서술의 '소음>태음>소양' 순서는 틀렸습니다). 얼굴 점수의 유형별 신뢰도는 소음 > 소양 > 태음 순으로 두되, one-vs-rest 정확도는 유형별 기저율(유병률)에 크게 좌우되므로 유형 간 직접 비교는 조심하세요. 저자들도 BMI와 성격 설문을 추가하라고 권고하므로 결합 구조의 근거로 쓰세요. 사용자에게 '얼굴 4체질 정확도'로 표기하면 안 됩니다.

papers.title: Sasang Constitution Detection Based on Facial Feature Analysis Using Explainable Artificial Intelligence (설명가능한 인공지능을 활용한 안면 특징 분석 기반 사상체질 검출)
papers.authors: Kim Jeongkyun, Ahn Ilkoo, Lee Siwoo (KIOM)
papers.design: Cross-sectional ML study. Facial images and KS-15 scores were collected from subjects confirmed by the Korean Medicine Data Center. Facial landmarks were converted into 2,279 facial-ratio features, tree-based models were trained, and SHAP was used for explanation. BMI and a personality questionnaire were added as extra inputs. The sample size was not visible in the results.
papers.findings: Reported accuracies were Tae-eum 81.90%, So-eum 90.49% and So-yang 81.90%, which appear to be per-type binary figures. Adding BMI and the personality questionnaire improved model performance. SHAP identified important facial features, but the specific top-ranked ratios were not visible in the results.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 우리 파이프라인(랜드마크 비율, 트리 모델, BMI와 성격 설문 결합)과 설계가 거의 같아 가장 실무적인 참고 문헌입니다. 원문에서 SHAP 상위 비율 특징을 확인해 특징 선택과 초기 가중치에 쓰세요. 수치는 유형별 이진 정확도이므로 사용자에게 '4체질 정확도 80–90%'로 표기하면 안 됩니다. KS-15 설문을 함께 수집한 점도 우리 설문 설계에 참고할 만합니다.

papers.title: Body Mass Index and Facial Cues in Sasang Typology for Young and Elderly Persons
papers.authors: Pham Duong Duc, Do Jun-Hyeong, Ku Boncho, Lee Hae Jung, Kim Honggie, Kim Jong Yeol
papers.venue: Evidence-Based Complementary and Alternative Medicine (2011, article 749209; DOI 10.1155/2011/749209)
papers.design: Cross-sectional analysis of 2D facial images from 911 participants. Only six Tae-yang participants were included, so the analysis covered only TE, SE and SY. Metrics included cheek-to-jaw width ratio (CJWR), width-to-height ratio (WHR), perimeter-to-area ratio (PAR) and eye size, tested against BMI. The figures of 1,013 recruited and 'two specialists per participant' were not visible and are unconfirmed.
papers.findings: Tae-eum generally had a squarer face. PAR, WHR, CJWR and eye size were associated with BMI. In Korean men the CJWR-BMI correlation was about twofold that reported for Caucasian and African men. The most parsimonious Tae-eum model used BMI + CJWR and had high predictive performance (AUC not visible). The male-specific claim that TE faces are 'squarer and wider than both SY and SE' was not visible in the results and is unconfirmed.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 광대폭/턱폭 비(CJWR)와 얼굴 폭/높이 비(WHR)를 핵심 얼굴 특징으로 측정하세요(MediaPipe 광대 끝과 하악각 랜드마크). 이 특징들은 BMI와 강하게 얽혀 있으므로 얼굴 점수와 BMI 점수를 단순 합산하면 이중 계산이 됩니다. BMI로 보정한 잔차를 쓰거나 결합 모델로 처리하세요. 또 태양인은 6명뿐이라 분석에서 빠졌으므로, 키오스크의 태양인 판정에는 얼굴 근거가 사실상 없다는 점을 고지하세요.

papers.title: Analysis of Facial Features according to Sasang Types between Native Japanese and Native Korean Populations
papers.authors: Ang Lin, Kim Jong Yeol, Lee Jeongyun
papers.design: Cross-sectional study, n=843: 127 native Japanese, plus 716 native Koreans from the Korea Constitutional Multicenter Bank (KCMB, 2007-2010). Facial feature points were placed automatically with the Sasang Constitutional Analysis Tool. Analysis was run separately by sample and by gender using one-way ANCOVA with age as a covariate.
papers.findings: Distinctive features among Sasang types were found mainly in lower-face area and eye shape, in both native Japanese and native Koreans. The authors suggest facial variables could be an objective tool in both populations but say further studies are needed to generalize. The sex-specific details from the original entry (male TE wider mid- and lower face; female TE larger lower-face width and area; female SY rounder eyes; SE more oval) were not visible in the results and are unconfirmed. Effect sizes not visible.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 하안면 폭과 면적(턱선 랜드마크 다각형 면적)과 눈 형태(세로 개방/가로 길이 비)를 성별로 나눠 측정하고, 나이를 보정 변수로 넣으세요(논문도 나이를 공변량으로 사용). 한국인과 일본인 모두에서 하안면과 눈 형태가 유의했다는 점은 동아시아인 대상 키오스크의 일반화 근거로 쓸 수 있습니다. 다만 방향(어느 체질이 더 넓은지)은 원문 표로 확인한 뒤 가중치에 반영하세요.

papers.title: Feature Selection from a Facial Image for Distinction of Sasang Constitution
papers.authors: Koo Imhoi, Kim Jong Yeol, Kim Myoung Geun, Kim Keun Ho
papers.design: Cross-sectional methods study, n=493 subjects classified by their reaction to oriental medicines. From 50 feature points on a frontal image the authors derived 1,225 distance, 61,250 angle and 749,700 distance-ratio features. Pipeline: outlier removal, missing-data control, then ANOVA.
papers.findings: The final selected set was 9 distances, 10 angles and 10 distance ratios. The authors expected angles and distance ratios to be the most efficient quantitative measures for classifying Sasang type, because angles depend less on body size. The specific features and their statistics were not visible.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 절대 거리보다 각도와 거리 비율 특징이 체격 영향을 덜 받아 체질 판별에 유리하다는 근거입니다. 수십만 개 후보 중 29개만 남았으므로 다중비교(우연한 유의성) 위험이 큽니다. 키오스크에는 여러 연구에서 반복 확인된 소수 특징(턱폭 비, 얼굴 폭/높이, 하안면, 눈 형태)만 쓰고 무작위 특징 탐색은 피하세요.

papers.title: 3D-AFRA facial measurements combined with SDQ 'first impression' items for Sasang discrimination in women aged 20-48 (exact Korean title not visible in search results)
papers.authors: Yoo Jeong-Hee (유정희) et al.
papers.design: Cross-sectional 3D facial study using 2007 multicentre data: 357 women aged 20-48, with Tae-yang excluded. Split into an analysis sample of 250 and a validation sample of 107. 3D-AFRA produced 332 measured and derived variables, which were screened with multiple comparisons, exploratory discriminant analysis and clinical judgement, then combined with 8 'first impression' items from the Sasang Diagnostic Questionnaire (SDQ) appearance section in a discriminant function. The '940 people with matching data' figure was not visible and is unconfirmed.
papers.findings: A discriminant function was built and validated on the held-out sample. The hit ratio and the selected variables were not visible in the results.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 얼굴 측정값과 '첫인상' 같은 주관적 설문을 결합한 사례입니다. 우리 설문에 '남들이 보는 내 인상' 문항을 넣는 근거로 쓸 수 있습니다. 학습과 검증 집단을 분리한 설계도 따라 하세요. 다만 3D 스캐너 기반이고 여성만 대상이므로 2D 웹캠 남녀 모델에 그대로 옮길 수는 없습니다.

papers.title: A Morphological Study of Ear, Eye, Nose and Mouth according to the Sasang Constitution (사상인 이목비구의 형태학적 특징 연구)
papers.authors: Hong SC (홍석철), Koh BH (고병희), Song IB (송일병)
papers.design: Cross-sectional anthropometric study using R. Martin's method on frontal, lateral and oblique photographs. n=209 patients and staff of the Kyung Hee Sasang constitution department.
papers.findings: Ear results visible in the abstract: morphologic and physiognomic ear length and ear-lobule length were longer in Tae-eum than So-eum; physiognomic ear breadth was wider in Tae-eum than So-eum; and the ratio of physiognomic ear length to lobule length was higher in Tae-eum than So-yang. Eye, nose and mouth results are in the paper's tables 3-10 but were NOT visible. The previously claimed palpebral-fissure and nasal-depth findings are unconfirmed and have been removed. p-values not visible.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 확인된 결과는 귀(태음인의 귀와 귓불이 더 길고 넓음)에 관한 것인데, MediaPipe Face Mesh는 귀를 추적하지 못하므로 키오스크에서 직접 쓰기 어렵습니다. 눈과 코 관련 수치는 원문 표를 확인하기 전까지 가중치에 넣지 마세요. 오래되고 작은 연구이므로 보조 근거로만 쓰세요.

papers.title: A study on 3D standard face modelling and facial feature derivation for Soyangin and Taeeumin (소양인과 태음인의 3차원 표준 얼굴 모델링과 얼굴 특징 도출에 관한 연구; English title per results: 'Taeeumin and Soyangin Modeling of the Three-dimensional Standard Face and Deriving of Facial Characteristics')
papers.authors: Lee Seon(-Young?) (이선/이선영), Hwang Min-Woo (황민우)
papers.design: Cross-sectional 3D facial study. 179 patients whose chief complaints clearly improved were recruited at Pusan National University Korean Medicine Hospital and Kangdong Kyung Hee Korean Medicine Hospital. So-yang and Tae-eum were compared by sex, and landmark distances, ratios and areas were tested statistically.
papers.findings: The authors built sex-specific 3D standard faces for So-yang and Tae-eum and identified statistically significant distance, ratio and area variables. The specific variables and numbers were not visible. The earlier alar-width and face-aspect claims were explicitly uncertain in attribution and are not confirmed by these results, so I removed them.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 태음인과 소양인 구분에 거리, 비율, 면적 특징을 성별로 따로 써야 한다는 근거입니다. 구체적인 특징(예: 코볼 폭, 얼굴 종횡비)은 원문에서 확인된 뒤에 반영하세요. 소음인과 태양인은 비교하지 않았으므로 해당 유형 판정에는 쓰지 마세요.

papers.title: Realtime Analysis of Sasang Constitution Types from Facial Features Using Computer Vision and Machine Learning
papers.authors: Abdullah, Shah Mahsoom Ali, Hee-Cheol Kim (James Cook University; Inje University)
papers.venue: Journal of Information and Communication Convergence Engineering 22(3):256-266 (Sept 2024)
papers.design: ML engineering study. Facial features (including forehead, nose and ears) are extracted from face images and fused to train several machine-learning models for real-time prediction. Dataset source, sample size and labelling method were not visible.
papers.findings: The paper presents a real-time AI system that predicts Sasang type from a face image using fused facial features. The originally claimed '32 significant geometric features', 'GBM best at 81%' and 'broadcast-production dataset' were NOT visible in the results and are unconfirmed.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 실시간 카메라 앱 구조(얼굴 검출, 특징 추출과 융합, ML 분류)가 키오스크와 비슷해 구현 참고용입니다. 데이터 출처와 라벨링(임상 확진 여부)이 확인되지 않았으므로 정확도 수치를 근거로 인용하지 마세요.

papers.title: 키넥트 센서를 이용한 실용적인 3차원 안면 진단기 연구 (A practical 3D facial diagnosis device using a Kinect sensor)
papers.authors: Jang Jun-Su (장준수), Do Jun-Hyeong (도준형), Kim Jang-Woong (김장웅), Nam Ji-Ho (남지호)
papers.venue: Journal of Physiology & Pathology in Korean Medicine (동의생리병리학회지) 29(3):218-222
papers.design: Device-agreement study. A Kinect for Windows v1 (structured-light 3D camera) system was tested for accuracy and repeatability, and its Sasang diagnosis results were compared with the existing DSLR-based 2D facial diagnosis system. The aim was a practical device for homes and small clinics. Sample size not visible.
papers.findings: Agreement between the Kinect-based and DSLR-based systems' Sasang diagnoses was kappa = 0.818, 'almost perfect'. This figure comes from an abstract copy on a secondary upload site and should be checked against the original PDF. The authors conclude that the 2D-image-based diagnostic algorithm can be used with 3D measurement and that Kinect is practical. This is inter-device agreement, not accuracy against true type.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 저가 깊이 카메라로도 DSLR 기반 알고리즘의 판정을 상당 부분 재현할 수 있다는 근거입니다. 다만 장비 간 일치도일 뿐 정답 체질과의 일치도가 아니라는 점을 분명히 하세요. 카메라나 장비를 바꿀 때 기존 결과와 일치도(kappa)를 검증하는 QA 절차의 근거로 쓰세요.

papers.title: A study on facial morphology by Sasang constitution (사상체질별 안면부 형태 연구)
papers.authors: Park Eun-A (박은아) et al.
papers.design: Cross-sectional photographic study. Lengths of nine facial regions were measured, converted to ratios and analysed statistically, with reference to the face-type criteria of 상학진전. The sample size (n=69), site (Semyung Univ. Chungju) and dates were NOT visible in the results and are unconfirmed.
papers.findings: So-eum faces were reported to be close to an oval or egg shape. Statistics not visible. (The 'small jaw area, long philtrum' So-eum description comes from a different study, Jang et al. 2010, not this paper.)
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 얼굴 부위 길이 비율(하안면 높이/전체 얼굴 높이, 하악폭/광대폭)이 작고 갸름한 계란형이면 소음 쪽 가중치를 주는 보조 근거입니다. 표본 크기를 확인하지 못했고 오래된 소규모 연구로 보이므로 단독 근거로 쓰지 말고, 대규모 연구와 방향이 같을 때만 반영하세요.

papers.title: 안면 형태학적 특성과 성격 특성 사이의 연관성에 대한 탐색 연구 (Exploratory study on the association between facial morphology and personality traits)
papers.authors: Baek YH (백영화) et al. (KIOM). The co-authors Kim SH, Do JH, Park KH and Jang ES were not shown in search results.
papers.design: Cross-sectional study of n=1,471 people recruited from Feb 2008 to Jul 2010. Participants were split into 3 groups by yin-yang personality score and compared with age-adjusted ANCOVA and Scheffe post-hoc tests (p<0.05).
papers.findings: The authors propose that yin-yang personality is associated with facial features, a topic earlier studies rarely examined. The variable-level results given in the submitted entry (men: SH36; women: FD50_51, SH36, FArea04, FAreaRatio4, FR01, FR05) did not appear in this check's search results. Treat them as unverified until they are read in the original. Variable definitions and effect sizes are not available here.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 설문의 성격·기질 문항(음양 성향)과 얼굴 지표가 서로 독립적이지 않을 수 있다는 근거입니다. 융합 모델에서 이중 계산이 생기지 않게 상관을 보정하는 것을 고려하세요. 어떤 변수가 남녀별로 유의했는지(SH36, FR01 등)는 이번 검증에서 확인되지 않았습니다. 원문에서 변수 정의와 결과를 확인한 뒤에 MediaPipe 지표와 대응시키고, 남녀 분리 모델이나 성별 공변량 여부를 정하세요.

papers.title: 형상분류를 이용한 성인여성의 체질별 안면형태 특징에 대한 연구 (A Study on the Characteristics of Facial Shape in Adult Women by Sasang Constitution Using Hyungsang Classification)
papers.authors: Jeon SH (전수형), Kim JW (김종원), Dong-eui University
papers.design: Cross-sectional study of n=1,011 adult women from a menstrual-pain clinical study. Each had digital photos and a 3D face scan from a face-only scanner. A Hyungsang medicine specialist rated each face against 5 diagnostic criteria; the specific criteria, such as eye-corner and nose-tip angles, were not visible in search results. Constitution came from the SSCQ-P questionnaire.
papers.findings: Most Korean adult women had angular faces (square or diamond shape), slanted eyes and upturned noses. Tae-eumin women were characterised by a wide face and a convex profile. Within Tae-eumin, 74.36% of faces were wide and 25.64% narrow, and 85.86% of profiles were convex and 14.14% concave. These figures come from an abstract excerpt and should be confirmed in the full text. The search results did not show comparable percentages for the other constitutions, so we cannot tell how specific these features are to Tae-eum. The submitted note that wide and convex faces predominated regardless of constitution did not appear in this check.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 형상의학 분류를 사상체질과 직접 연결한, 가장 큰 규모(1,011명)의 형상의학 실증 연구입니다. 태음인 가중치 후보는 '얼굴 폭이 넓음(얼굴 폭/길이 비 높음)'입니다. 다만 다른 체질의 비율이 확인되지 않아 태음인 특이도를 알 수 없으므로 가중치는 약하게 두세요. 측면 돌출(convex profile)은 정면 2D MediaPipe로는 측정이 어려워 제외하거나 '측정 불가'로 표기하세요. 대상이 성인 여성(생리통 임상연구 참가자)뿐이라는 한계도 알려야 합니다.

papers.title: Differences in Complexion between Cold- and Heat-Prescription Groups in Sasang Medicine
papers.authors: Park et al. (Park, Do, Kim, Kim per search summary)
papers.venue: Evidence-Based Complementary and Alternative Medicine (DOI 10.1155/2017/9701978; PMID 28883886)
papers.design: Cross-sectional study of 528 Sasang prescriptions from the Korea Constitutional Multicenter Bank. Prescriptions were classified as Cold or Heat following 'Longevity and Life Preservation in Oriental Medicine'. Complexion was measured in L*a*b* colour space. Analysis used ANCOVA adjusted for age, BMI and systolic BP, by sex.
papers.findings: After adjusting for age, BMI and systolic blood pressure, complexion differed significantly between the Cold- and Heat-prescription groups within each Sasang constitution. When constitution was ignored, no significant difference was found. The authors treat complexion as an important diagnostic factor linked to disease of the five viscera. The classical background descriptions in the submitted entry (healthy So-eum skin soft violet, unhealthy So-eum turbid yellow, healthy Tae-eum shiny violet) were not visible in this check's results. The actual L*, a* and b* means were also not visible.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 볼·이마·코의 Lab 값을 쓰는 설계가 학술적으로 타당하다는 근거입니다. 핵심 시사점은 안색이 체질을 직접 판별한다기보다 '체질 안에서의 한열(寒熱) 상태'를 반영한다는 점입니다. 따라서 Lab은 체질 분류 가중치보다는, 판별된 체질 안에서 한/열 경향을 코멘트하는 데 쓰세요(예: 설문의 추위·더위 선호와 교차 확인). 나이·BMI 보정도 필요합니다.

papers.title: 사상의학과 형상의학의 유형분류의 연관성에 관한 연구 (Study on the association between Sasang medicine and Hyungsang medicine type classifications; English rendering is ours)
papers.authors: Dong-eui University researchers. Individual names were not shown in search results, and the submitted 'Jang et al.' was not confirmed.
papers.venue: Journal of Sasang Constitutional Medicine (사상체질의학회지) 22(3). Pages 75-86 were not shown in search results.
papers.design: Cross-sectional study of n=430 volunteers (278 men, 152 women) recruited by advertisement. Sasang constitution was diagnosed by questionnaire and compared with Hyungsang classification. The number of Hyungsang raters (5 specialists in the submitted entry) did not appear in search results.
papers.findings: Sasang diagnosis and Hyungsang classification were significantly associated. According to the search summary, Taeyangin had significantly more bladder-body (방광체), Gi-kwa (기과), Taeyang-type (태양형) and Yangmyeong-type (양명형) faces, and Taeeumin had more gallbladder-body (담체) faces. Soyangin and Soeumin also each had their own over-represented types, but the details were not shown. The extracted text was partly garbled, so verify the counts and statistics in the original PDF.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 형상의학 유형(담체/방광체, 정·기·신·혈과 등)과 사상체질을 한 화면에 함께 보여 줘도 된다는 실증적 연결고리입니다. 검색 요약상 태양인은 방광체·기과·태양형·양명형, 태음인은 담체가 많았다고 합니다. 다만 사상체질 라벨이 설문 기반이고 형상 판정은 전문가의 주관적 판단이라는 한계가 있습니다. 화면에는 '연관성(같은 개념은 아님)'으로만 표기하고, 방향성은 원문 표를 확인한 뒤 약한 가중치로 반영하세요.

papers.title: 얼굴 데이터를 이용한 형상의학에서의 진단정확률 제고 방법 (Improving diagnostic accuracy in Hyungsang medicine using face data)
papers.authors: Not shown in search results
papers.venue: 한국자료분석학회지 (Journal of the Korean Data Analysis Society)
papers.design: Cross-sectional study of n=300 (140 men, 160 women) using 3D face data plus questionnaire items from a Korean medicine diagnostic system. Stepwise discriminant analysis was used for variable selection and linear discriminant analysis for diagnostic accuracy. A related paper in the same series used the consensus of 5 experts observing face shape as ground truth (n=780). Whether this paper used the same ground truth is not confirmed. The details of 51 landmarks, 332 variables and the clinical-trial source were not visible in this check.
papers.findings: 3D face data alone gave diagnostic accuracy of 0.7576 in men and 0.7834 in women. Adding the Korean medicine diagnostic questionnaire raised it to 0.8106 in men and 0.8217 in women, gains of 5.30 and 3.83 percentage points. Whether cross-validation was used is not visible in the search results.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: '얼굴만'보다 '얼굴+설문'이 더 정확하다는 정량 근거(약 4~5%p 향상)로, 키오스크의 얼굴+설문 융합 구조를 정당화합니다. 정확도 약 76~82%는 3D 얼굴 데이터 기준이므로, 2D 웹캠 MediaPipe에서는 더 낮을 수 있다고 알려야 합니다. 교차검증 여부가 확인되지 않아 정확도가 과대평가됐을 수 있습니다. 남녀를 따로 분석한 점도 참고하세요.

papers.title: 설명가능한 인공지능을 활용한 안면 특징 분석 기반 사상체질 검출 (Sasang Constitution Detection Based on Facial Feature Analysis Using Explainable AI)
papers.authors: Kim JG (김정균), Ahn IG (안일구), Lee SW (이시우), KIOM. KIOM authorship was confirmed; the individual names were not shown in this check's search results.
papers.venue: Journal of Sasang Constitutional Medicine (사상체질의학회지), July 2024. KoreaScience record JAKO202424057609701; the journal name was not explicit in the snippet.
papers.design: Cross-sectional machine-learning study using face photos and KS-15 scores from the KIOM Korean Medicine Data Center. Facial landmarks gave 2,279 ratio features. Tree-based classifiers were used with SHAP explanations, and BMI and a personality questionnaire were added as inputs. Sample size was not stated in the snippets.
papers.findings: SHAP identified the key facial ratio features, and adding BMI and the personality questionnaire improved model performance. The per-type accuracies quoted in the submitted entry (81.90% Taeeum, 90.49% Soeum, 81.90% Soyang) were again not visible in this check. Treat them as unverified until they are checked in the full text. Whether Taeyang was excluded was also not visible.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 키오스크 구조(랜드마크 비율 + BMI + 성격 설문)와 가장 비슷한 최신 연구입니다. SHAP으로 '어떤 얼굴 비율이 판정에 기여했는지'를 사용자에게 보여 주는 설명 UI의 선례가 됩니다. 라벨은 KS-15 설문 점수를 사용했습니다. 태양인은 표본이 적어 많은 모델에서 다뤄지지 않으므로, 태양인 판정에는 '근거 부족' 경고를 표시하세요. 정확도 수치는 원문 확인 전까지 화면에 쓰지 마세요.

papers.title: The Association between Facial Morphology and Cold Pattern
papers.authors: Ahn I, Bae KH, Jin HJ, Lee S
papers.design: Cross-sectional study (KIOM). A fully automated facial shape analysis computed angle, area and distance features from 68 landmarks. These were tested against a questionnaire-based cold pattern score (CPS) with Pearson and partial correlation. Sample size was not stated in the snippets.
papers.findings: 37 facial features correlated significantly with CPS (unadjusted). The angle of the face outline near the ear and the chin-line angle were positively associated with CPS. Upper and lower chin widths were negatively associated. Overall, higher CPS went with a more pointed chin, a longer face, a more angular jaw, higher-set eyes and upturned mouth corners. The submitted claim that upper-face area and face area excluding the sensory organs were negatively associated did not appear in this check, so I replaced it with the chin-width finding that did. Coefficients and sample size are not visible.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: MediaPipe 468점(68점의 상위집합)으로 같은 지표(귀 근처 얼굴 윤곽 각도, 턱선 각도, 턱 폭)를 재현할 수 있습니다. 설문의 추위·더위 선호, 손발 온도 문항과 교차 확인하는 '한증(寒證) 경향' 보조 지표로 쓸 수 있습니다. 다만 다중비교를 보정하지 않은 결과라 가중치는 작게 두고 '경향'으로만 표현하세요. 이 연구는 사상체질이 아니라 한증과의 연관 연구입니다.

papers.title: 고연령 한국 남성의 사상 체질별 건강 수준에 따른 안색의 정량적 분석 (Quantitative analysis of facial complexion by health level and Sasang constitution in elderly Korean men)
papers.authors: Do JH (도준형), 구본초, 김장웅, 장준수, 김상길, 김근호, 김종열 (KIOM)
papers.design: Cross-sectional study of Korean men aged 65-80. 205 took part and 85 were included in the final analysis. Colour feature variables were extracted from frontal facial images by image processing. The submitted note about 114 subjects with 2-expert agreement and 3 features per region did not appear in this check and was removed.
papers.findings: The study examined correlations between complexion and health status, between complexion and health status within each constitution, and between Sasang types within the healthy group. The authors' motivation was that few prior studies had compared the complexion of healthy and unhealthy groups by constitution. Specific numeric results are not visible in the search results.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 정면 얼굴 영상에서 안색 변수를 자동으로 뽑는 파이프라인은 키오스크의 Lab 추출 방식과 같습니다. 안색이 '체질 판별'보다 '건강 수준' 지표로 연구되었으므로, 안색은 건강 상태 코멘트용으로 쓰는 것이 타당합니다. 65~80세 남성 85명이라는 작은 표본이라 일반화에 한계가 있다는 점도 알리세요.

papers.title: The Association of Quantitative Facial Color Features with Cold Pattern in Traditional East Asian Medicine
papers.authors: Mun S, Ahn I, Lee S
papers.design: Cross-sectional study, Dec 2014 to Mar 2015, using data from the KIOM Korean Medicine Data Center. 64 participants were analysed after one with missing data was excluded. Digital camera images had facial regions selected automatically, colour features were converted to CIELAB, and each region's parameters were tested against a questionnaire cold pattern score. Colour-chart correction was not mentioned in this check's results.
papers.findings: Whole-face colour values were negatively associated with cold pattern score, so people with a stronger cold pattern tended to have paler faces. The authors conclude objective facial diagnosis is useful for pattern identification. The submitted coefficients (whole face B=-1.048, P=0.021; lower cheek B=-0.494, P=0.007; chin B=-0.640, P=0.031) did not appear in this check's results. Neither did the specific identification of a* (redness) as the parameter, nor the cited prior work on forehead, cheek and nose L* and a*. Treat these as unverified until they are read in the full text.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 얼굴색이 창백할수록 '한(寒) 경향'이라는 방향성 근거입니다. 어떤 Lab 성분(a* 붉은기 등)과 어떤 영역(아래 볼, 턱 등)이 유의했는지, 그리고 계수는 원문(PMC5664382 표)을 확인한 뒤에 가중치에 반영하세요. 색 보정(화이트밸런스 고정 또는 컬러차트)이 필요하고, 조명이 통제되지 않은 키오스크에서는 신뢰도가 낮다는 경고를 붙여야 합니다. 표본이 64명이라 약한 가중치로만 쓰세요. 사상체질이 아니라 한증 연구입니다.

papers.title: 면색정보취득 制御條件 표준화 및 윤택측정방안 설계 (Standardising control conditions for facial-colour acquisition and designing a luster measurement method; English rendering is ours). Title taken from one search summary. The submitted title '망색(望色) 진단 객관화에 관한 고찰: 면부 안색과 윤택' was not found.
papers.authors: Chi KY (지규용), Kim JW (김종원), per one search summary
papers.venue: J Physiol & Pathol Korean Med (동의생리병리학회지), 2015. Volume/pages 29(4):289-294 were not shown in search results.
papers.design: Review of prior studies on objectifying facial colour inspection, plus the design of a method to judge luster (潤澤) and a colour-space representation for a diagnostic database
papers.findings: According to search excerpts, facial colour inspection centres on complexion and luster (潤澤), and local areas are also examined (head, hair, eyes, nose, ears, lips, teeth, gums, throat, neck, skin). The face gets the most emphasis because its rich blood supply from the stomach meridian reflects the state of qi and blood, and its thin skin makes colour and luster changes easy to see. The authors call earlier studies sketchy, with almost nothing on database methods, and focus on a luster-detection design and a colour-space representation. They also note that facial colour changes with emotion, through facial-artery and sympathetic control, so this must be considered during image acquisition. The submitted list of recommendations (light source, brightness, polarising filters, camera distance, posture) and the Neijing remark did not appear in this check. There are no quantitative results. The topic is general Korean-medicine colour inspection, not specific to Sasang or Hyungsang.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 키오스크 촬영 조건(고정 조명, 색온도, 촬영 거리, 정면 자세 가이드)과 촬영 전 안정 시간(정서 변화가 면색에 영향)을 정하는 참고 문헌입니다. 다만 편광 필터 같은 구체적 권고 항목은 이번 검증에서 확인되지 않았으니 원문을 확인하세요. 촬영 조건이 갖춰지지 않으면 면색 결과를 '참고용'으로 낮춰 표시하는 로직의 근거로 쓸 수 있습니다. 윤택(광택) 측정은 별도 지표로 설계할 수 있습니다.

papers.title: 정기신혈과(精氣神血科)의 형상(形象)에 대한 연구 (Study on the Shapes of Jung-kwa, Gi-kwa, Sin-kwa, Hyul-kwa)
papers.authors: Choi BT, Choi YH, Baek GG, Lee YT (author order differs between listings)
papers.venue: Korean Journal of Oriental Physiology & Pathology (동의생리병리학회지) 19(5):1181-1190. The search confirmed an October 2005 KoreaScience record; the journal name and volume/pages were not explicit in the snippet.
papers.design: Theoretical and textual analysis of Jisan (Park In-kyu)'s Hyungsang theory
papers.findings: The four categories are treated as the materialised forms of essence (bone marrow), qi, spirit and blood. The authors infer that Jisan regarded Jung-kwa, Gi-kwa, Sin-kwa and Hyul-kwa as round, square, inverted-triangle, and triangle-or-oval shapes respectively. Viscera links are Jung-kwa to Kidney, Gi-kwa to Lung, Sin-kwa to Heart and Hyul-kwa to Liver. The abstract also explains shapes by each category's nature: blood, which dislikes moving, is placed in a round form so it moves easily, and qi, which tends to scatter, in a square form so it stays. That passage appears to give a round form to blood, which conflicts with the main mapping (Jung round, Hyul triangle or oval), so verify it in the full text. No empirical data.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 정기신혈 유형을 얼굴 윤곽(둥근형/사각형/역삼각형/삼각·타원형)으로 매핑하는 문헌적 근거입니다. 얼굴 폭/길이 비, 턱 폭/이마 폭 비로 윤곽 유형을 근사할 수 있습니다. 혈과의 형태 서술에 초록상 모순이 있으므로 원문 확인 전에는 혈과 매핑을 잠정적으로 두세요. 실증 연구가 아니므로 화면에는 '전통 이론에 따른 해석'으로 분명히 구분해 표시해야 합니다.

papers.title: 장상논(臟象論)과 어조주갑류(魚鳥走甲類)에 대한 고찰 (Concepts on Appearance Diagnosis and Four HyungSang Types: Fish, Bird, Horse, and Turtle)
papers.authors: Kim JW (Kim Jong-Won) et al., Dong-Eui University. The submitted note that the English page lists Kim KK and Lee YT was not checked here.
papers.design: Theoretical and textual review
papers.findings: Appearance diagnosis (臟象) reads the five zang organs from the eyes, nose, mouth and ears. The four Hyungsang types (fish, bird, horse, turtle) are judged by the external shape formed as the type of seed changes, but they also relate back to the five zang organs. The two systems assign the nose, eyes, ears and mouth to the Five Elements differently. The zang-fu organs are shaped by internal conditions and the four types by external ones. The paper suggests a disease in the more developed part of the body may be hard to cure. No empirical data.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 어·조·주·갑류 설명 문구와 '이목구비 형태 → 오장' 해석 텍스트의 출처로 쓸 수 있습니다. 눈 크기, 코 폭, 입 폭, 입술 두께 등 MediaPipe 지표를 오장 해석에 연결할 때 인용하세요. 두 체계에서 이목구비-오행 배속이 다르다는 점을 해석 문구에 반영해야 합니다. 실증적 정확도 근거는 없으므로 '형상의학 전통 해석'으로 표기하세요.

papers.title: 형상의학(形象醫學)의 정의(定義)와 특징(特徵)에 대한 고찰 (A Study of Hyungsang Medicine's definition and features)
papers.authors: Park JK (박준규), Kim NI (김남일), Kyung Hee University
papers.design: Historical and theoretical review
papers.findings: Hyungsang medicine is a theory established by Park In-kyu (Jisan) based on the Donguibogam. It differs from the Donguibogam in basing diagnosis and treatment on the person's external appearance. The paper examines how it relates to other medical theories and reviews its source texts. No empirical data.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 키오스크 '형상의학이란?' 소개 화면의 정의 문구 출처로 쓰세요(지산 박인규 창시, 동의보감 기반, 외형을 진단 기준으로 삼음). 이 분야 근거의 대부분이 이론·문헌 연구이고 실증 연구는 소수의 횡단 연구라는 점을, 근거 수준 표시와 함께 정직하게 안내하는 데 활용하세요.

papers.title: Sasang constitutional types for the risk prediction of metabolic syndrome: a 14-year longitudinal prospective cohort study
papers.authors: Lee S (Sunghee Lee) et al.
papers.design: Prospective cohort, n=3,529 adults aged 40-69, Korean Genome Epidemiology Study (KoGES), followed 2001-2014. The search results did not confirm the Ansan arm or the use of Cox models.
papers.findings: No participants were classified as Tae-yang, so only TE, SE and SY were analysed. Incident metabolic syndrome risk was highest in TE, then SY, then SE. Adding SC type significantly raised the prediction model's AUC to 0.8173 (the baseline AUC was not shown). Significant predictors differed by type, but the snippets did not say which ones. The earlier claim that BMI predicted MetS in TE and SY but not in SE could NOT be confirmed and has been removed. The full text says TE had higher BMI and waist circumference than SY and SE.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 14년 전향 코호트 근거로 '태음인 > 소양인 > 소음인 순으로 대사증후군 발생 위험이 높았다'는 건강 안내 문구를 뒷받침할 수 있음. 태음인의 BMI·허리둘레가 더 높았다는 점도 확인됨. 단 '소음인에서는 BMI가 예측인자가 아니었다'는 내용은 확인되지 않았으므로 체질별 BMI 해석 분기 근거로 쓰지 말 것. 표본에 태양인이 0명이었다는 점을 고지해야 함.

papers.title: The prevalence of general and abdominal obesity according to sasang constitution in Korea
papers.authors: Baek Y, Park K, Lee S, Jang E
papers.design: Cross-sectional, n=3,348 from 24 Korean medicine clinics; obesity assessed by BMI, waist circumference (WC) and waist-to-hip ratio (WHR)
papers.findings: General obesity was BMI>=25 (Asia-Pacific WHO criteria). The exact WC and WHR cut-offs used in this paper were not visible in the snippets. General obesity was significantly more common in men than in women. TE had the highest prevalence of general obesity, WC-defined abdominal obesity and WHR-defined abdominal obesity in both sexes, followed by SY and then SE. TE odds ratio for general obesity was 20.2 (95% CI 12.4-32.9) in men and 14.3 (95% CI 10.1-20.2) in women. TE odds ratio for WC-defined abdominal obesity was 10.7 (men) and 7.5 (women). The reference group was not named in the snippets (probably SE). Per-type prevalence percentages were not visible.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: BMI 25 이상과 태음인 사이의 연관이 매우 강함(일반비만 OR 남 20.2, 여 14.3; 허리둘레 복부비만 OR 남 10.7, 여 7.5). 키/몸무게로 계산한 BMI를 태음인 가중치를 높이는 근거로 사용 가능. 단 체질 판정 자체가 체형을 반영하므로 순환논리가 섞일 수 있다는 주의 문구를 표시할 것. 비교 기준군이 초록에 명시되지 않았으므로 OR 수치를 인용할 때는 '논문 보고값'으로 표기.

papers.title: Constitutional multicenter bank linked to Sasang constitutional phenotypic data
papers.authors: Jin HJ et al.
papers.venue: BMC Complementary and Alternative Medicine (doi 10.1186/s12906-015-0553-3; PMID 25887924)
papers.design: Biobank description: Korea Constitutional Multicenter Bank (KCMB), 24 Korean medicine clinics; clinical data on 3,711 participants (1,353 men, 2,358 women) aged over 10. Search snippets conflict on the start date, giving both 'since 2006' and 'since August 2012'.
papers.findings: After direct standardisation, the estimated type distribution was TE 39.2%, SE 27.1%, SY 33.7%, and TY <0.1%. The frequencies of hypertension, diabetes, hyperlipidemia, stroke and obesity differed notably by type (P<0.001); per-disease numbers were not visible. The claim that the TE share was about 10 percentage points lower than Lee Je-ma's estimate was not confirmed in snippets and has been removed.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 베이지안 사전확률(prior)로 사용 가능: 태음인 약 39%, 소양인 약 34%, 소음인 약 27%, 태양인 <0.1% (직접표준화 추정치). 태양인 결과는 극히 드물다는 점을 키오스크에 고지하고, 태양인 판정 임계값을 매우 높게 설정할 근거. 다른 연구(예: 2013년 남성 태음인 44.8%)와 분포가 다르므로 prior는 고정값이 아닌 조정 가능한 파라미터로 둘 것.

papers.title: Exact title not shown in search results: study testing whether BMI and waist-circumference cut-offs for metabolic syndrome differ by Sasang constitution
papers.authors: Not confirmed (one search summary referred to it as 'Yu et al., 2018'; unverified)
papers.design: Cross-sectional, n=3,117 South Koreans aged 20-90; MetS defined by revised NCEP-ATPIII; age-adjusted cut-offs by Sasang type
papers.findings: BMI and WC cut-offs for identifying MetS varied by Sasang type. The snippet listed these age-adjusted pairs: SY 22.2 / 80.5, TE 25.2 / 89.1, SE 21.9 / 80.3 (BMI kg/m2 / WC cm). The snippet did not say whether they are sex-specific or pooled. The previously listed values for men under 40 (SY 25.9/89.9, TE 25.5/90.5, SE 21.8/86.2) and the age split (men at 40, women at 50) could not be confirmed and have been removed.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 체질별 BMI 경고 기준을 다르게 적용할 근거: 소양인/소음인은 BMI 약 22, 태음인은 약 25 부근이 대사증후군 판별 cut-off(연령보정값, 성별 구분 여부 미확인). '당신 체질 기준 참고 BMI' 안내 문구에 활용 가능(진단이 아닌 참고 정보로 표기). 성별·연령별 세부 기준은 원문 확인 전까지 사용하지 말 것.

papers.title: Predicting Sasang Constitution Using Body-Shape Information
papers.authors: Jang E, Do JH, Jin H, Park K, Ku B, Lee S, Kim JY
papers.venue: Evidence-Based Complementary and Alternative Medicine 2012 (doi 10.1155/2012/398759; PMID 22792124)
papers.design: Tool development (SCAT-B): sex-specific multinomial logistic regression on 8 body circumferences, their pairwise ratios, height, weight and BMI. Recruitment was reported as 23 clinics and 2,677 subjects, though one snippet gave 8 clinics and 463 subjects, so sample details are inconsistent across sources. Training and test sets were used.
papers.findings: The type was taken as the maximum of three constitutional probability scores, with predictive power measured by Cohen's kappa. Overall predictability was 63.1% (kappa 0.411) in men and 55.3% (kappa 0.314) in women. Using only cases with a probability score >50 raised this to 69.1% (kappa 0.470, men) and 64% (kappa 0.429, women); it is unclear from the snippet whether these figures are training or test set. TE was predicted best (about 80% in the male training set, about 74% in the male test set) and SY worst (about 35-54% depending on sex and set). The earlier per-type figures (training 80.2/56.9/37.7, test 60.5/81.5/30.3, kappa 0.387/0.298) and the mean BMI table were NOT confirmed. The male TE test figure even conflicts with the search summary (about 74% vs 60.5%), so those numbers have been removed.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 체형 정보만으로는 정확도 약 55~69%, kappa 약 0.31~0.47 수준(중간 이하) — 키/몸무게만으로 체질을 단정하면 안 된다는 정직한 한계 고지 근거. 태음인은 체형으로 비교적 잘 예측되나 소양인은 잘 구분되지 않음 → 소양인은 설문(성격·한열) 가중치를 높일 것. 확률 50 초과일 때만 결과를 확정 표시하는 신뢰도 임계값 방식 참고. 체질별 평균 BMI 수치는 확인되지 않았으므로 likelihood 중심값으로 쓰려면 원문 표를 직접 확인해야 함.

papers.title: Could the Sasang constitution itself be a risk factor of abdominal obesity?
papers.authors: Jang E et al.
papers.design: Cross-sectional, n=2,528 adults over 30 from 23 clinics; abdominal obesity (AO) by waist circumference; constitution assigned by Korean medicine experts
papers.findings: AO prevalence by type in men: TE 63.7%, SE 14.7%, SY 32.8%. In women: TE 84.8%, SE 41.7%, SY 52.8%. The authors concluded TE may be significantly and independently associated with AO and could be considered a risk factor. They call this indirect evidence and note the cross-sectional, clinic-recruited, expert-classified design. A 44.8% TE share among men was reported elsewhere for this study. The overall AO prevalence (42.8% M / 62.1% F), the remaining type-distribution figures and the exclusion of TY were not confirmed in snippets.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 허리둘레 정보가 없더라도 '복부비만 경향' 설문 문항을 태음인 지표로 쓸 근거(남 태음인 63.7% vs 소음인 14.7%). 성별 사전확률 차이(남성 태음인 비율이 높음)를 prior에 반영 가능. 전문가 판정 기반 단면연구이므로 판정자 편향·인과 불명이라는 점을 표시.

papers.title: Development and Validation of Brief KS-15 (Korea Sasang Constitutional Diagnostic Questionnaire) Based on Body Shape, Temperament and Symptoms
papers.authors: Baek Y, Jang E, Park K, Yoo J, Jin H, Lee S
papers.design: Questionnaire development using a constitutional diagnosis databank from 11 nationwide multi-centres; training n=1,645, test n=222
papers.findings: KS-15 has 15 self-report items on a three-option scale covering body shape, temperament and symptoms. Type is assigned by tallying TE, SE and SY scores and taking the highest. The original paper's validation statistics were not visible. The 1 body / 6 temperament / 8 symptom split, the age-adjusted BMI weighting and the KS-10 PCP of 60% were NOT confirmed in snippets and have been removed. Follow-up studies seen in search: test-retest agreement of 87.13% (kappa 0.794) in young adults, and one-year agreement of 75.8% (kappa 0.618) in university students.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 키오스크 설문+체형 구조의 직접적인 모델(체형·기질·증상 3영역, 3지선다, 최고점 체질 선택). 재검사 일치도(87%, 1년 후 76%)를 '설문 결과도 시간에 따라 달라질 수 있음' 고지 근거로 사용. 문항 구성 비율과 BMI 연령보정 방식은 원문 확인 후 반영할 것. 원 논문 정확도 수치는 확인되지 않았으므로 정확도 수치를 인용하지 말 것.

papers.title: A Study on the Sasang Constitutional Characteristics by Obesity Grade
papers.authors: Yeo HR, Kim KK, Lee MH, Park YC, Jeon SH, Kwon SD, Jung SI, Kim JW
papers.design: Cross-sectional, n=2,268 patients treated with Sasang medicine (1,341 female, 927 male), aged 17-80, from Seoul, Busan, Daegu and Jeonju; body shapes classified by BMI
papers.findings: SE tended toward underweight and TE toward overweight. The authors concluded that sex, age group and obesity grade should all be considered when distinguishing Sasang constitutions. Not confirmed in snippets, and removed: the BMI 23 overweight threshold, sex-specific types in the normal-weight group, and the claim that body measurements were unreliable in the underweight group. Per-group percentages were not visible.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 저체중은 소음인, 과체중은 태음인 쪽 가중치 근거. 비만도·성별·연령을 함께 고려해야 한다는 결론은 BMI 특징을 성별·연령으로 보정하는 설계 근거. 정상체중 구간의 성별별 경향이나 저체중군 판별 불안정성은 확인되지 않았으므로 해당 분기 로직의 근거로는 쓰지 말 것.

papers.title: Exact English title not shown in snippet: Sasang-type cut-off values of abdominal circumference and BMI for metabolic syndrome in the Wonju genomic cohort
papers.authors: Choi JW, Yu JS (최재완·유준상) — romanisation of second author unconfirmed
papers.design: Cross-sectional analysis of the community-based Wonju genomic cohort (2006-2013); NCEP ATP III criteria with Asia-Pacific abdominal-obesity thresholds. n=1,773 was not confirmed in snippets.
papers.findings: MetS prevalence was 34.8% in men and 37.6% in women. Overall cut-offs were WC 88.3 cm (men) and 80.3 cm (women), and BMI 24.2 kg/m2 (men) and 25.3 kg/m2 (women). Cut-offs for SY and SE were lower, and the authors recommend lowering cut-offs for SY and SE. Not confirmed, and removed: the TE-specific cut-offs (men WC 88.8 / BMI 25.6; women WC 80.3 / BMI 24.9) and the claim that TE was the most significant risk type.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 2018년 연구와 같은 방향(소양인·소음인은 더 낮은 BMI·허리둘레에서도 대사 위험)을 독립 코호트에서 재확인 → 체질별 참고 BMI 안내의 근거를 2편으로 제시 가능. 단 체질별 구체 수치는 원문 확인 전까지 2018년 연구 값만 사용.

papers.title: Best-fit index for describing physical perspectives in Sasang typology
papers.authors: Chae H, Kown Y
papers.design: Cross-sectional nationwide sample, n=1,663 aged 31-60; ponderal index (PI), BMI and BMR compared across Sasang type, age and sex using box plots, Pearson correlation and ANOVA
papers.findings: BMI correlated with PI at r=0.933 and with BMR at r=0.577. The authors concluded that PI, BMR and BMI each have their own clinical value and could help study the mechanism of Sasang typology via a hypothalamus hypothesis. The snippets did not name a single best index. Not confirmed in snippets, and removed: the explicit statement that types differed significantly on all three indices, and the remark that BMI is easily mistaken for a pathological obesity measure.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 키/몸무게로 BMI 외에 Ponderal Index(체중/키^3)도 함께 계산해 보조 특징으로 사용 가능(BMI와 r=0.93으로 중복성 큼 → 둘 다 넣을 때 다중공선성 주의). 'BMI는 병적 비만 지표로 오해되기 쉽다'는 문구는 확인되지 않았으나, 결과 문구에서 '태음인=비만'이 아닌 '체격이 큰 체형'으로 표현하는 것은 설계상 권장.

papers.title: Machine learning-based prediction of Sasang constitution types using comprehensive clinical information and identification of key features for diagnosis
papers.authors: Park et al.
papers.design: Multicenter clinical dataset with 248 features (body measurements, personality, physiological and pathological symptoms). Diagnoses were made by Sasang specialists with 5+ years of practice. ERT, SVM, multinomial logistic regression and KNN were compared with cross-validation. n=1,338 was not confirmed in snippets.
papers.findings: Extremely randomized trees performed best, with overall F1 0.60 +/- 0.060. Body measurement, personality, general information and cold-heat feature classes were the most decisive. Costal angle was the single most informative feature. In pairwise comparisons, body measurements mattered most for some type pairs, and personality and cold-heat features for another. Per-type performance was not visible.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 전체 임상정보를 다 써도 F1 약 0.60 → 키오스크 정확도 기대치를 현실적으로(약 50~60%) 고지하는 근거. 체형 + 성격 + 한열(추위/더위 선호) 문항이 가장 중요하다는 결과를 설문 문항 우선순위와 가중치 설계에 직접 반영. 최상위 특징(늑골각)은 카메라로 측정 불가 → 체형 정보 손실을 한계로 고지.

papers.title: 대학교 신입생 건강검진에서 시행된 신체계측, 혈액검사, 음주 흡연 여부와 사상체질의 연관성 평가 (Association of anthropometry, blood tests, drinking and smoking at a freshman health exam with Sasang constitution)
papers.authors: 정미경, 오현숙 외 (Jung MK, Oh HS et al.; Kyungwon University College of Korean Medicine)
papers.venue: 동의생리병리학회지 (Journal of Physiology & Pathology in Korean Medicine) 25(6):1079-1084
papers.design: Cross-sectional: of 2,817 freshmen who had a health exam, 1,570 with complete data were analysed. Sasang type was the response variable; height, weight, BMI, laboratory values, drinking and smoking were explanatory variables. The QSCC II classification and the factor-analysis step were not confirmed.
papers.findings: The aim was to evaluate whether health-exam anthropometry, blood tests, drinking and smoking relate to Sasang type and to propose objective criteria. The snippets did not show specific results. The claims that BMI and weight were the most effective discriminating factors, and that TE mean BMI was 24.8 +/- 3.65, were NOT confirmed and have been removed. The same group published a related 2012 study of 3,815 university students in 한방예방의학회지 16(3); this corrects the earlier figure of 2,387.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 젊은 성인(20대 초반) 대상 체질-신체계측 연관 연구가 존재한다는 근거로만 사용 가능. 구체적 판별력(BMI가 가장 유효한 변수인지)은 확인되지 않았으므로 낮은 연령대 방문자에 대한 BMI 가중치 정당화 근거로는 원문 확인 후 사용.

papers.title: A Study on the Body Shape classified by Sasang Constitutions and Gender using Physical Measurements
papers.authors: Jeon SH, Sul YK, Kim KK, Lee EJ, Kim JW
papers.design: Cross-sectional, n=562 patients treated with Sasang constitutional medicine; body circumferences and widths converted to ratios based on Sasang theory
papers.findings: SY had high axillary-width:waist-width and chest-width:iliac-width ratios, meaning a relatively large upper body. TE had low head and neck circumference relative to body circumference. SE had the highest head:waist circumference ratio. TY women had the largest iliac:chest width ratio and TY men the smallest. Across all types, men had higher axillary:waist and chest:iliac ratios than women. The authors conclude that sex and type-specific body shape must be considered when classifying by physical measurements. Numeric values were not visible.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 카메라로 상반신(어깨폭/허리폭)을 측정할 수 있다면 '상체 상대적으로 넓음=소양인', '머리 대비 허리 가늘음=소음인' 방향성 특징 근거. 모든 체형 비율은 반드시 성별로 정규화해야 함. 수치 기준은 없으므로 방향성(약한 가중치)으로만 사용.

papers.title: Resting Metabolic Rate for Diagnosing Tae-Eum Sasang Type and Unraveling the Mechanism of Type-Specific Obesity
papers.authors: Park J, Lee S, Lee Y, Lee J, Chae H
papers.design: Cross-sectional, n=395 healthy participants typed by the Sasang Constitutional Analysis Tool (SCAT); skeletal muscle mass, body fat mass and RMR measured, also standardised by body weight; logistic regression
papers.findings: The TE group had significantly higher body weight, BMI, body fat mass and unstandardised RMR (kcal/day) than the other groups. TE had lower RMR per body weight (kcal/day/kg) and lower percent skeletal muscle. Logistic regression found RMR per weight pivotal for separating TE from other types and for explaining TE-type obesity. Effect sizes and AUC were not visible.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 태음인 해석 문구 근거: '체중 대비 기초대사량이 낮고 근육 비율이 낮은 경향 → 근력운동 권장'. 키오스크는 RMR을 직접 측정하지 못하므로 판별 특징이 아닌 건강 조언 텍스트로만 사용.

papers.title: Lower cellular metabolic power can be an explanation for obesity trend in Tae-Eum type: hypothesis and clinical observation
papers.authors: Shim EB, Leem CH, Kim JJ, Kim JY
papers.venue: Integrative Medicine Research (September 2017; reported as 6(3):254-259, volume/pages not shown in snippets)
papers.design: Hypothesis paper with clinical observation on 548 individuals. The SCAT typing, per-type counts (TE 182, SE 166, SY 200) and BMR figures were not confirmed in snippets.
papers.findings: Cellular metabolic rate was lower in TE, and the share of TE with BMI >25 was significantly higher than in other groups (percentages not visible). The proposed mechanism is weaker mitochondrial oxygen consumption in TE, framed by the metabolic scaling law. A 2009 Korean-language version on 863 subjects reported the same pattern. A later review notes the result depends on normalisation: REE normalised to fat-free mass was identical across types, and only TE men showed low REE normalised to weight. Removed as unconfirmed: the male BMR values (1782.73 vs 1566.24) and the per-type counts.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 태음인 비만 경향의 기전 '가설' 수준 근거 — 결과 화면에서는 '가설'로 명시해야 함. 제지방량으로 정규화하면 체질 간 차이가 사라진다는 후속 리뷰가 있으므로 근거 수준 표시를 '낮음/논쟁 중'으로 설정.

papers.title: 체질진단설문지 정확률 연구의 연구방법론 고찰 (Methodological review of diagnostic-accuracy studies of Sasang constitution questionnaires)
papers.authors: Kim SH, Jang E, Koh BH (김상혁, 장은수, 고병희)
papers.design: Methodological systematic review: MEDLINE, Cochrane Library, KISS and DBPIA searched; 28 questionnaire diagnostic-accuracy studies assessed with QUADAS
papers.findings: 28 studies were included. On the QUADAS risk-of-bias assessment, 'acceptable reference standard', 'uninterpretable results reported' and 'withdrawals explained' were very weak. The authors suggest a reporting checklist and call for future studies to fix these problems. The abstract gives no pooled accuracy figure. The companion Eur J Integr Med 2013 QSCC II review was not searched, so it is not verified here.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 근거 페이지 맨 위에 둘 핵심 경고입니다. 설문지 정확도 연구는 기준 진단(전문가 진단)의 질이 낮고 보고도 불완전합니다. 그래서 '정확도 OO%'를 단정적으로 보여주면 안 됩니다. 이 논문 자체에는 통합 정확도 수치가 없습니다. 50~70%대 범위는 아래의 개별 연구(QSCC II, KS-15, SCAT)에서 가져와 표시해야 합니다.

papers.title: 로지스틱 회귀분석을 이용한 태음인 수면의 임상적 특징 (Clinical characteristics of Tae-eum sleep using logistic regression)
papers.authors: Choi JR et al. (최정락 외)
papers.design: Cross-sectional, n=1,229 patients (529 male) at Dongguk University Bundang Oriental Hospital; sleep questionnaire; binary logistic regression comparing Tae-eum with the other constitutions
papers.findings: Binary logistic regression compared the daily sleep patterns of Tae-eum and non-Tae-eum patients. The snippet's summary was ambiguous: it described Tae-eum sleep as showing features similar to non-Tae-eum. So it is not confirmed that specific items clearly discriminate Tae-eum. Specific items, odds ratios and accuracy were not stated in the visible abstract.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 설문의 '수면' 영역과 태음인의 관련성을 탐색한 연구입니다. 다만 수면 문항이 태음인을 뚜렷하게 구별한다는 점은 초록에서 확인되지 않습니다. 원문에서 문항별 OR을 확인하기 전에는 수면 문항에 큰 가중치를 주지 말고 보조 문항으로만 써야 합니다.

papers.title: Biopsychological traits of Sasang typology based on Sasang personality questionnaire and body mass index
papers.authors: Lee et al.
papers.design: Large nationwide clinical sample (exact n not visible in snippet); SPQ factor structure reconfirmed; SPQ (temperament) and BMI (body type) profiled per Sasang type, standardized across sex and age
papers.findings: The study used the 14-item SPQ as the temperament measure and BMI as the body-type measure, after reconfirming the SPQ's factor structure. Its background cites prior work: Tae-eum lies between So-yang and So-eum psychologically, and has a higher BMI and larger chest circumference. This is a cited prior finding, not a result visible from this paper. The paper's own per-type SPQ and BMI results were not visible in the snippets.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: '성격(SPQ)'과 'BMI'를 두 개의 독립 축으로 쓰는 2차원 판정의 설계 근거입니다. 선행연구에 따르면 성격 축에서는 태음인이 소양과 소음의 중간이고, 태음인은 BMI가 높습니다. 다만 이 논문 자체의 체질별 수치는 원문에서 확인한 뒤에 가중치에 반영해야 합니다.

papers.title: 사상체질분류검사(QSCC II)의 재현성에 관한 연구 (Reproducibility of the QSCC II over repeated annual testing)
papers.authors: Hwang DS, Cho JH, et al. (황덕상, 조정훈 외)
papers.design: Retrospective repeated-testing study at Kyung Hee University Kangnam Korean Hospital, Jan 2002 to Dec 2005; QSCC II given in 2 or 3 successive years
papers.findings: 333 of 584 subjects (56.88%) got the same constitution on the second-year test, and 45 of 81 (55.56%) on the third-year test. The authors call the roughly 56% reproducibility a severe limitation for constitution diagnosis and recommend combining several objective methods. The claimed 2002 Wonkwang study with 51% agreement did not appear in the results and was removed.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 옛 설문(QSCC II)만으로 판정하면 같은 사람이 해마다 다시 해도 약 56%만 같은 결과가 나온다는 점을 솔직하게 알려야 합니다. 설문·얼굴·BMI를 결합하는 다중 모달 설계를 정당화하는 근거입니다.

papers.title: 사상체질분류검사지(QSCC II)의 Upgrade 연구 (II) - 사상체질분류검사지(QSCC II)의 재타당화 연구 (Re-validation of QSCC II)
papers.authors: Lee SK, Kwak CK, Lee EJ, Koh BH, Song IB (이상규, 곽창규, 이의주, 고병희, 송일병)
papers.design: Cross-sectional; QSCC II given to 537 patients at Kyung Hee Oriental Medicine Hospital, Sep 2000 to Mar 2002; crosstabs, variance and discriminant analysis
papers.findings: Discrimination without the weight was Tae-yang 61.5%, So-yang 57.7%, Tae-eum 67.2% and So-eum 68.8%, mean 65.0%. With the weight it was 76.9%, 59.9%, 68.9% and 71.2%, mean 67.3%. The authors suggest trying other discriminant methods and say the Tae-yang and So-yang items need development.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 체질별 판별력 차이를 보여주는 대표 수치입니다. 소양인 문항이 일관되게 약하다는 점(57.7~59.9%)을 확인할 수 있습니다. 가중치를 적용하면 평균 판별력이 2.3%p 오르므로, 문항 가중치 조정의 근거가 됩니다. 판별분석 결과(내부 적합)이므로 실제 정확도는 이보다 낮을 수 있다고 안내해야 합니다.

papers.title: 개정(改定)된 사상체질분류검사지(四象體質分類檢査紙)II의 신뢰도(信賴度)와 타당도(妥當度)에 대한 연구 (Reliability and validity of the revised QSCC II)
papers.authors: Choi KJ et al. (최경주 외), Kyung Hee University Sasang Constitutional Medicine dept.
papers.design: Reliability: 266 people each tested three times about 1 year apart. Validity: 587 people compared with Sasang specialist diagnosis
papers.findings: Test-retest kappa was 0.311 to 0.414. Same-result probabilities were So-yang 54.5%, Tae-eum 68.1% and So-eum 65.7%. Agreement with specialist diagnosis (n=587) was 58.4%, rising to 60.8% with an age limit (kappa 0.412, moderate). Agreement was lower in subjects in their 70s.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 고령층(70대)에서는 설문과 전문의 진단의 일치도가 떨어지므로, 연령대별로 결과의 신뢰도 표시를 낮춰야 합니다. 1년 간격 반복 측정의 κ가 0.31~0.41로 낮다는 점도 근거 페이지에 밝혀야 합니다.

papers.title: The Preliminary Study on the Coincidence between Sasang Constitutional Analysis Tool β-version and Expert of Sasang Constitution
papers.authors: Jang E, Jin HJ, Do JH, Lee SW, Kim JY (Jang et al., KIOM)
papers.design: Agreement study: 371 subjects from 6 oriental medical clinics; SCAT β-version (face, voice, body shape, questionnaire) compared with expert diagnosis using kappa and coincidence rates
papers.findings: Overall agreement between SCAT β and experts was 69.3%: Tae-eum 73.2%, So-eum 70.8%, So-yang 56.9%. The source is internally inconsistent on kappa: 0.510 in the text and 0.521 in Table 1. The claims about agreement rising with SCAT probability, the 1,457 total records and the Yanbian study (kappa 0.408, 61.1%) were not visible and were removed.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 얼굴·체형·음성·설문 통합 도구가 전문가와 약 69% 일치하고(κ 약 0.51) 소양인에서 가장 낮다(56.9%)는 근거입니다. 결과 화면에 체질별 확률을 보여주고, 소양인 판정에는 더 낮은 신뢰도를 표시해야 합니다. 확률이 높을수록 일치도가 오른다는 점은 이 논문에서 확인되지 않았으므로 Do 2012의 cut-off 결과를 근거로 써야 합니다.

papers.title: One year test-retest reliability of the Korea Sasang constitutional diagnostic questionnaire (KS-15) in university students
papers.authors: Bae et al.
papers.venue: Journal of Sasang Constitution and Immune Medicine (사상체질의학회지)
papers.design: Test-retest over 1 year in university students (sample details 149 of 583 not visible in snippets)
papers.findings: Agreement on Sasang constitution diagnosis was 75.8% (kappa 0.618, substantial). The authors judged KS-15 reliable over one year and called for more work on reliability, validity and use across age groups. Per-type agreement (TE 85.1%, SE 73.6%, SY 58.6%) and the item-level kappa range (0.161 to 0.620) were not visible and are unverified. A separate 2-week study of young adults (n=303, 14-day interval) reported 87.13% agreement (kappa 0.794).
papers.kiosk_use_ko: KS-15형 설문은 QSCC II(1년 재현율 약 56%)보다 재현성이 높아(1년 75.8%, 2주 87.1%) 키오스크 설문의 기반으로 적합합니다. 체질별·문항별 안정성 수치는 원문에서 확인한 뒤에 문항 가중치 조정에 써야 합니다.

papers.title: Development and Validation of a Personality Assessment Instrument for Traditional Korean Medicine: Sasang Personality Questionnaire
papers.authors: Chae H, Lee S, Park SH, Jang E, Lee SJ
papers.design: Instrument development, n=245 (students of the Korean medicine schools at Pusan National Univ. and Wonkwang Univ.); internal consistency and exploratory factor analysis; convergent validity against TCI and NEO-PI
papers.findings: The 14-item SPQ had Cronbach's alpha 0.817 and test-retest r=0.837. Three subscales (behavior, emotionality, cognition) explained 55.77% of total variance. Convergent validity was checked against TCI and NEO-PI. A 2012 clinical validation study (koreascience JAKO201229140688204) used SPQ with PANAS and BMI (225 analyzed participants), and later studies tested adolescents. Subscale reliabilities (0.748 etc.) and the specific follow-up findings were not visible and were removed.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 설문의 '성격/기질' 영역은 SPQ의 3개 하위척도(행동·감정·인지, 14문항)를 본떠 구성하는 것이 좋습니다. 신뢰도가 양호합니다(α 0.817, 재검사 0.837). 외향적·적극적일수록 소양, 내향적·소극적일수록 소음 쪽으로 점수를 줍니다.

papers.title: Development and Validation of the Digestive Function Assessment Instrument for Traditional Korean Medicine: Sasang Digestive Function Inventory
papers.authors: Lee M, Bae NY, Hwang M, Chae H
papers.design: Instrument development and validation, n=193 Korean-medicine students at Pusan National University (97 retested); Sasang type by QSCC II; factor analysis; validity checked against other measures including BMI
papers.findings: The 21-item SDFI has three subscales (Digestion, Appetite, Eating pattern) that explained 56.02% of total variance. Cronbach's alpha was 0.743 and test-retest r=0.886. Items per subscale (10/6/5) and the specific correlations with NDIK, FDRQOL and DEBQ were not visible and are unverified. A 2021 revision used 419 hospital patients to cut the inventory from 21 to 15 items, and a 2021 validation reported test-retest 0.801 to 0.887. Which KoreaScience record (JAKO202128557516170 or ...517170) holds which result was not clear.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 식욕·소화·식습관 문항은 SDFI의 3개 요인 구조를 따르는 것이 좋습니다. 하위척도의 문항 수가 다를 수 있으므로, 하위척도별로 평균을 내서 같은 비중으로 합산해야 합니다. 원 연구 표본이 한의대생 193명이므로, 일반 방문객에게 적용할 때는 한계가 있다고 안내해야 합니다.

papers.title: Biopsychological and pathophysiological features of Cold-Heat subgroup of Sasang typology (full title truncated in search results)
papers.authors: Lee J, Han SY, Hwang M, Bae N, Chae H
papers.design: Cross-sectional, 241 patients; SDFI, SPQ and BMI measured; logistic regression predicting Cold vs Heat subgroup within each Sasang type
papers.findings: Cold and Heat subgroups differed on SDFI, SPQ and BMI in So-yang; on SDFI and BMI in Tae-eum; and on SDFI-Digestion in So-eum. SDFI-Digestion was a substantial predictor in all three types. The SDFI+SPQ+BMI model correctly predicted 81.9% (So-yang), 77% (Tae-eum) and 75.5% (So-eum) of Cold-Heat subgroups. The authors say further clinical studies are needed before generalizing.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 체질 판별 다음 단계로, 체질 안의 한(寒)/열(熱) 아형을 안내하는 근거입니다. 소화 기능 문항(SDFI-소화)이 세 체질 모두에서 한열 구분에 기여하므로, 결과 리포트의 '한열 경향' 설명에 소화 문항 점수를 우선 반영합니다. 표본이 241명이라 일반화에는 한계가 있다는 점을 함께 표시해야 합니다.

papers.title: P05.20. A study on the intra-reliability of Sasang Constitutional diagnosis by experts
papers.authors: Jang E, Baek Y, Park K
papers.venue: BMC Complementary and Alternative Medicine 12(Suppl 1):P380 (conference poster)
papers.design: Expert re-diagnosis study: subjects re-interviewed by experts about 1 year later; final diagnosis of 86 subjects (39 male, 47 female) by mutual agreement; Cohen's kappa
papers.findings: Individual experts' kappa between their first and second diagnoses ranged from 0.380 to 0.768. When two experts agreed at the first step, kappa against the final diagnosis was 0.874; with three experts agreeing it was 0.893. A related 2014 J Sasang Constitut Med study by Baek and colleagues (koreascience JAKO201430169051955) concluded that expert concordance and validity seem moderate. Its specific kappa range (0.283 to 0.421) was not visible and was removed.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 모든 설문과 알고리즘 정확도의 '정답'인 전문가 진단도 개별 전문가의 자기 일치도가 κ 0.38~0.77에 그칩니다. 그래서 키오스크 정확도의 상한은 본질적으로 제한됩니다. 이 사실을 면책 문구와 근거 페이지에 반드시 넣고, 결과를 확정 진단이 아닌 참고용 경향으로 표시해야 합니다.

papers.title: The obesity-risk variant of FTO is inversely related with the So-Eum constitutional type: genome-wide association and replication analyses
papers.authors: Cha et al.
papers.design: GWAS with replication in two Korean populations, total n=5,490 (discovery 3,810; replication 1,680)
papers.findings: The obesity-risk variant in FTO intron 1 (rs7193144) was inversely associated with the So-Eum type independent of BMI. The same variant's association with Tae-Eum disappeared after BMI was controlled. The authors suggest FTO may play a role in body constitution type, since SE has the lowest body mass and cardiometabolic susceptibility. The specific OR (0.729) and p-value (1.47e-7) were not visible in the search results and have been removed. The study was framed as addressing replication problems in earlier constitution GWAS. The exact wording about 'non-objective type classification' was not seen.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 키오스크에서 유전자 측정은 불가. '소음인=마른 체형/체중 증가 경향 낮음'이라는 체형 규칙에 생물학적 근거가 일부 있다는 설명 자료로만 사용. 태음인-FTO 연관은 BMI로 설명되므로, 알고리즘에서 BMI와 태음인 점수를 이중으로 더하지 않도록 주의.

papers.title: Predicting type 2 diabetes using Sasang constitutional medicine
papers.authors: Cho et al. (per search summary; full author list not shown)
papers.design: 10-year prospective cohort linked to Sasang constitution typing (Ansung-Ansan / KoGES); the subset size with Sasang evaluation and the person-years were not visible in snippets
papers.findings: 472 incident type 2 diabetes cases (incidence density 215/10,000). Tae-Eum vs So-Eum relative risk 1.696 (95% CI 1.204-2.39, P=0.003). No difference between So-Eum and So-Yang. The authors conclude that the TE type is a strong risk factor for T2DM independent of obesity level. The subset size (2,460 of 10,038), the 22,007 person-years and the HOMA-IR/HOMA-beta results were not visible in the search results.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 태음인 판정 시 '당뇨 위험 관리' 안내 문구의 근거로 사용 가능(비만과 독립적인 위험). 이는 질병 위험과의 연관이지 진단 지표가 아니므로, 혈당·인슐린 값을 체질 판정 입력으로 쓰지 말고 결과 해설용으로만 사용.

papers.title: A practical approach to Sasang constitutional diagnosis using vocal features
papers.authors: Jang JS, Ku B, Kim YS, Nam J, Kim KH, Kim JY
papers.design: Voice-based SC classification using sentence recordings only (no vowels); multinomial logistic regression trained via LASSO; 3-class problem (Tae-yang excluded as too rare). Sample size and number of features were not visible in search results.
papers.findings: The authors propose a practical model with few variables, lower complexity and only short sentence recordings, suited to u-health and mobile use. They note earlier voice studies used small samples from few sites. Test-set accuracies (47.9% male / 40.4% female), n=2,341 and 21 features could not be found in any search result, including a targeted retry, so they have been removed. The list of contributing acoustic features from related Korean studies was not checked and has been removed.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 마이크를 추가하더라도 음성은 보조 지표로 낮은 가중치만 부여(구체적 정확도 수치는 원문 확인 전까지 인용하지 말 것). 짧은 문장 낭독만으로 측정 가능하다는 점은 키오스크 UX 설계에 유용. 3분류(태양인 제외) 모델이라는 점과 남녀 모델 분리 필요성 고지.

papers.title: Prevalence of Metabolic Syndrome according to Sasang Constitutional Medicine in Korean Subjects
papers.authors: Song KH, Yu SG, Kim JY (Song, Yu & Kim)
papers.design: Cross-sectional, n=1,617 outpatients of Korean oriental medicine hospitals (KIOM), classified into So-Yang, So-Eum, Tae-Eum; metabolic syndrome by modified NCEP ATP III criteria
papers.findings: Overall metabolic syndrome prevalence was 35.37%. By type: SE 18.02%, SY 30.59%, TE 48.85%, with significant differences by type in both sexes. The authors conclude that constitution may be a significant risk factor. ORs of TE 4.52 (95% CI 3.36-6.07) and SY 2.00 (1.47-2.74) vs SE appear in a 2017 paper that cites this study, but the snippets could not confirm that they are this paper's own values. The claimed 4.521/2.004 should be checked against the original table. The earlier draft's 'pooled 3-cohort analysis, TE 2.05-fold, SY 1.41-fold' was not seen and has been removed.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 태음인 > 소양인 > 소음인 순의 대사위험 패턴이 여러 데이터셋에서 반복된다는 근거(유병률 TE 48.9%, SY 30.6%, SE 18.0%). 결과 해설에서 체질별 생활습관 권고(태음인: 체중·혈압·지질 관리)를 뒷받침하는 인용으로 사용. 병원 외래환자 표본이라 일반 인구로 일반화하기 어렵다는 점을 함께 표기.

papers.title: Genome-Wide Association Analysis of Sasang Constitution in the Korean Population
papers.authors: Kim BY, Jin HJ, Kim JY
papers.venue: Journal of Alternative and Complementary Medicine 18(3):262-269 (journal not shown in snippets; PMID 22394158 / PMC3306582 match)
papers.design: GWAS, n=1,222 subjects of defined constitution type; 341,998 loci after QC; functional relationship analysis of loci with p<=1e-4
papers.findings: 15 genes, including GPM6A, SYT4 and GRIK1, were associated with the TE type (p<0.05 in the gene-level analysis), and other gene sets were linked to SE and SY. The specific SE/SY gene names in the draft (DRGX, AKAP11, ZFP42, CDH22, ALDH1A2, OTX2, EN2) were not visible in snippets and have been removed. The later Cha et al. 2015 study was designed to address replication problems in earlier constitution GWAS. The claim that these signals 'did not reach genome-wide significance' was not directly seen.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 키오스크에 직접 반영할 지표는 없음. '체질의 유전적 근거는 아직 확립되지 않았고 재현되지 않았다'는 정직한 근거 고지 섹션에 FTO 연구(Cha 2015)와 함께 인용.

papers.title: Comparisons of Sasang constitution classification accuracy using radial pulse waves (Cho JK, 732 health-check visitors)
papers.authors: Cho JK (조재경), Gyeongsang National University
papers.venue: Journal of the Korea Academia-Industrial cooperation Society (한국산학기술학회논문지) 21(2):359-365, DOI 10.5762/KAIS.2020.21.2.359
papers.design: Cross-sectional, n=732 Korean medicine hospital health-check visitors. Reference constitution was classified by questionnaire. Radial pulse features were pulse width and peak magnitude and count. A discriminant function was trained and applied with 5-fold cross-validation. The age range (40-60s), the Chon/Gwan/Cheok sites and 'QSCC II with physician decision' were not visible in the snippets.
papers.findings: Before age/sex adjustment: Taeumin 73.6%, Soeumin 68.4%, Soyangin 74.2%, overall 72.5%. After weighting to the Korean population age/sex structure: Taeumin 70.4%, Soeumin 84.2%, Soyangin 67.7%, overall 73.8%. The draft's claim of 'a separate 2008 study (n=1,420), Taeum easiest / Soyang hardest' was not seen and has been removed. A related 2009 study by Shin & Kim in the same journal compared classification methods for pulse waves and recommended logistic regression or decision trees that account for BMI.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 맥진기 없이 카메라만 쓰는 키오스크에는 직접 적용 불가. 다만 객관적 생체신호 단독으로도 약 70%대 정확도가 보고된다는 비교 기준선으로 사용. 기준 체질이 설문 분류라 순환 검증 가능성이 있음을 주의 문구로 표시.

papers.title: 원주 지역 주민들의 사상체질과 심박수변이도와의 상관성 (Correlation between Sasang constitution and heart rate variability in Wonju residents)
papers.authors: Kim SY et al. (김수연 외 4명)
papers.venue: 대한한방내과학회지 (Journal of Korean Oriental Internal Medicine) 30(3):510-524
papers.design: Cross-sectional, n=665 rural Wonju adults (280 M, 385 F), aged 39-72; constitution diagnosed by a Sasang specialist using PSSC (search summaries also mention face/tongue photos and a checklist); HRV by SA-2000 (Medi-core), time and frequency domain
papers.findings: In women under 60, Taeeumin and Soeumin had significantly lower odds ratios than Soyangin for LF norm and LF/HF ratio, and significantly higher odds ratios for HF norm. In women 60 and over there was no significant HRV-constitution correlation. The results for men were not visible in the search results. The draft's statement of 'no significant correlation in men' and the 2007 8,498-worker 'no significant relation' claim were not confirmed and have been removed.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 카메라 rPPG로 HRV를 측정하더라도 효과가 60세 미만 여성 하위군에서만 확인되므로 판정 가중치는 0 또는 매우 낮게. '소양인=교감신경 우세 경향' 정도의 해설 문구에만 조심스럽게 사용.

papers.title: Thermoregulatory Responses to Graded Exercise Differ among Sasang Types
papers.authors: Pham et al.
papers.design: Experimental cross-sectional, n=304 apparently healthy adults aged 20-49 with Sasang type determined; chest and back sweat rates measured during a maximal treadmill exercise test
papers.findings: TE had larger body size, higher % body fat and lower BSA-to-mass ratio than the other types, especially SE. Chest sweat rates in TE men were higher than in SE and SY men. In women, back sweat rate was higher in TE than in the other types. The tendency remained after normalizing for workload, metabolic heat production, temperature increment load and BSA. TE tended to have shorter time to exhaustion and lower VO2max. The authors conclude TE is the most susceptible to heat stress. Effect sizes were not visible.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 설문의 '땀이 많다' 문항을 태음인 쪽으로 가중하는 객관적 근거. '더위를 많이 탄다/운동 시 쉽게 지친다' 문항도 태음인 보조 지표로 활용 가능. 땀은 체지방과 얽혀 있으므로 BMI와 중복 가산 주의.

papers.title: Recent Progress in Voice-Based Sasang Constitutional Medicine: Improving Stability of Diagnosis
papers.authors: Jang JS, Kim YS, Ku B, Kim JY
papers.venue: Evidence-Based Complementary and Alternative Medicine (DOI 10.1155/2013/920384), published 2013-08-26
papers.design: Voice data from 23 oriental medical clinics (Tae-Yang excluded due to small sample); repeatability test set of 10 individuals x 50 recordings each
papers.findings: The authors note earlier voice studies used unstable features that vary a lot within the same person, data from only a few sites and low accuracy, and none evaluated repeatability. They propose a stable diagnosis model with good repeatability for the same individual. The 'Gaussian mixture model on frame-level features' detail was not visible in the search results and has been removed. Specific accuracy and repeatability numbers were also not visible.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 같은 사람이 여러 번 측정해도 결과가 바뀌는 문제(재현성)를 키오스크에서도 반드시 점검해야 한다는 근거. 얼굴 랜드마크도 여러 프레임의 평균을 내고, 반복 측정 시 체질이 뒤바뀌는 비율을 내부 품질지표로 기록.

papers.title: Comparison of Gut Microbiota between Sasang Constitutions
papers.authors: Kim et al.
papers.design: 16S rRNA pyrosequencing of gut microbiota in normal-weight adults aged 19-65; Tae-yang excluded (too rare among recruits); total n not visible in snippets
papers.findings: In male subjects aged 20-29, Firmicutes appeared more abundant in SE and Bacteroidetes in TE. The draft's 'dominant across types' wording was incorrect. At genus level, Bifidobacterium and Bacteroides differed between SE and TE. Body weight, BMI and waist circumference were significantly higher in TE than in the other types. The abstract says the link holds only within a narrow age range. The authors call for further study of age, sex and other factors.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 키오스크에서 측정할 수 없는 항목. 설문의 소화·대변 문항이 체질과 연관될 수 있다는 탐색적 근거 정도로만 언급하고, '예비 연구(20대 남성 한정)' 라벨을 붙여 표시.

papers.title: Exploring Heart Rate Variability as a Biomedical Diagnostic Tool for the Disympathetic Dimension of Eight-Constitution Medicine
papers.authors: Kang H, Walsh S, Oliver B, Royce T, Cho BJ
papers.design: Critical review of HRV studies in Korean constitutional medicine, covering both Eight-Constitution Medicine (ECM) and Sasang Constitutional Medicine (SCM), assessed against three considerations including the HRV-constitution correlation; whether formal systematic-review methods were used and the number of included studies were not visible
papers.findings: Because study design, study population and HRV measures were inconsistent, the data did not consistently support HRV as a biomedical determinant of ECM constitutions. The review's motivation was finding an objective marker separating Sympathicotonic and Vagotonic types. The number of included studies was not visible.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: HRV(또는 카메라 rPPG 기반 심박변이)를 체질 판정 입력으로 넣지 말아야 할 근거. 근거 페이지에 '자율신경 지표는 체질 판별 근거가 일관되지 않음'으로 명시. 8체질이 주 대상이나 사상체질 HRV 연구도 함께 검토한 리뷰임을 표기.

papers.title: 사상체질 진단 연구의 전문가 일치도와 진단 정확률 (Expert agreement and diagnostic accuracy in Sasang constitution diagnosis studies)
papers.authors: Han Eun-Kyung, Kwon Young-Kyu (한은경, 권영규)
papers.venue: 동의생리병리학회지 (Journal of Physiology & Pathology in Korean Medicine); volume/issue/pages (32(4):185-196) and the DOI were not shown in search results
papers.design: Literature review of 127 Sasang diagnosis studies published 1987-2017
papers.findings: 127 papers were analysed. 56.0% were published in the Journal of Sasang Constitutional Medicine. A Sasang specialist took part in 96.3% of expert-judged cases. Among cases with two or more experts, inter-expert agreement was reported in only 14.8%. The wording in the results points to this being how often agreement was reported, not an agreement level. Either way, the 'expert gold standard' is rarely checked. The authors recommend reflecting the state of diagnostic consensus in guideline development and strengthening expert training. The 'about 4.1 papers per year' figure could not be confirmed and is removed. Pooled kappa and accuracy numbers were not stated.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: '전문의 진단 = 정답'이라는 전제부터 검증이 부족하다는 핵심 근거(전문가 2인 이상 사례 중 전문가 간 일치도를 보고한 경우가 14.8%뿐). 키오스크 결과 화면에 '한의사 간에도 체질 판정이 엇갈릴 수 있고, 그 일치 여부조차 잘 검증되지 않았다'는 고지를 넣고, 알고리즘을 전문의 진단으로 검증할 때 그 기준 자체가 불안정하다는 점을 근거 페이지에 설명할 것.

papers.title: 체질진단설문지 정확률 연구의 연구방법론 고찰 (Methodological review of accuracy studies of constitution diagnosis questionnaires)
papers.authors: Kim Sang-Hyuk, Jang Eun-Su, Koh Byung-Hee (김상혁, 장은수, 고병희)
papers.design: Methodological systematic review of 28 diagnostic-accuracy studies. Sources: MEDLINE, Cochrane Library, KISS and DBpia, plus a hand search of major Korean medicine journals. Two independent reviewers assessed quality with the QUADAS tool.
papers.findings: 28 studies were included. On QUADAS, three items came out 'very weak': acceptable reference standard, reporting of uninterpretable results, and explanation of withdrawals. The authors call for better study design and a reporting checklist. No pooled accuracy was given. Earlier claims could not be confirmed in search results and were removed: items with unclear reporting (spectrum, delay, incorporation, blinding) and a cited QSCC II accuracy of about 51% with Taeyang being hard to diagnose.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 설문 정확도 수치(60~80%)를 그대로 인용하면 안 되는 이유: 포함된 정확도 연구 대부분이 참조표준(전문의 진단)의 적절성이 약하고 탈락·판정불가 사례 보고가 부실함. 키오스크 '근거' 페이지에 '보고된 설문 정확도는 연구 설계상 과대평가됐을 수 있음'을 명시할 것.

papers.title: A Systematic Review on Sasang Constitutional Type-Associated Susceptibility to Disorders in Korea
papers.authors: Lee HY et al.
papers.venue: Journal of Alternative and Complementary Medicine 22(12):950-956
papers.design: Systematic review of seven databases; 14,272 records screened, 15 studies covering 13 disorders included
papers.findings: Six of 13 disorders differed significantly in prevalence by Sasang type: prehypertension, general obesity, abdominal obesity, metabolic syndrome, diabetes mellitus and IBS. Metabolic syndrome and related disorders were most prevalent in Taeeum (TE) types, and IBS in Soeum (SE) types. The authors conclude that susceptibility is affected by type 'to some extent' and needs further study. This is a prevalence comparison. The abstract gives no pooled effect sizes.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 태음인 결과에 '대사증후군·비만 경향 관리' 같은 생활 조언을 붙일 근거는 되지만, 진단·위험 예측처럼 표현하면 안 됨. BMI·나이 교란이 크므로 BMI를 체질 점수와 별도 변수로 다루고, 질병 관련 문구에는 '연관성 연구 결과이며 개인 진단 아님' 경고를 반드시 붙일 것.

papers.title: Systematic review of type-specific pathophysiological symptoms of Sasang typology
papers.authors: Han et al.
papers.design: Systematic review of six databases, 1990-2015; 35 articles analysed
papers.findings: Symptoms were grouped into six categories: perspiration, temperature preference, sleep, defecation, urination and susceptibility to stress. TE and SE types showed contrasting features, with SY in between. The authors use an autonomic-reactivity hypothesis: TE has a low parasympathetic activation threshold and SE a low sympathetic one. This is a hypothesis, not a demonstrated mechanism. Per-item effect sizes were not stated in the abstract.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 설문 문항(땀, 한열 선호, 수면, 대변, 소변, 스트레스) 가중치의 '방향'을 잡는 근거. TE와 SE를 양극으로, SY를 중간값으로 두는 1차원 축 설계에 활용. 다만 자율신경 가설은 미검증이므로 사용자 화면에 메커니즘처럼 쓰지 말 것.

papers.title: Systematic Review on Researches of Sasang Constitution Diagnosis Using Facial Feature
papers.authors: Lee SY, Koh BH, Lee EJ, Lee JH, Hwang MW (이선영 등)
papers.venue: Journal of Sasang Constitutional Medicine (사상체질의학회지) 24(4):17-27, DOI 10.7730/JSCM.2012.24.4.17
papers.design: Systematic review of dissertations and papers on using facial form for Sasang diagnosis, published up to September 2012 (RISS4U, OASIS, KISTI, Korean TK databases)
papers.findings: A uniform tendency in facial form by Sasang constitution was found. The authors conclude that standardizing diagnosis through a Sasang clinical protocol must come first, and that practical use of facial form should be decided only after that. Diagnosis should also consider subdivided symptomatology. The number of included studies, feature-direction tables and accuracy figures were not stated in the results.
papers.kiosk_use_ko: 얼굴 형태가 체질별 '경향'을 보인다는 근거지만 표준 프로토콜이 없으므로 얼굴 점수 단독 판정은 금지. 얼굴 모듈은 보조 신호로만 쓰고 가중치를 낮게 시작할 것. 촬영 거리·각도·조명을 고정하는 키오스크 촬영 프로토콜을 자체 표준으로 문서화할 것.

papers.title: The change in Sasang constitution prediction value and the associated factors using KS-15 questionnaire
papers.authors: Park Ji-Eun et al. (Korea Institute of Oriental Medicine)
papers.design: Two-year follow-up of Korean Medicine Data Center cohort participants, KS-15 at baseline and two years later; n=5,784
papers.findings: 1,402 of 5,784 participants (24.2%) had a different KS-15 constitution prediction after two years. Change was most common in So-yang (SY) and least common in Tae-eum (TE).
